subject: Post-demo: Compliance checklist & EU residency / export-control questions
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martin <elena.martin@medbridgehealth.com>
Cc: Procure <procure@medbridgehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up + compliance checklist from today's demo

Hi Elena — thanks again for your time on the demo this morning. Thought I'd capture the compliance items you flagged and next steps so nothing gets lost: 

1) SOC 2 status — you asked whether Redwood is SOC 2 Type II certified and whether we can share evidence / controls mapping.
2) Data residency — you need explicit EU-region tenancy for PHI-adjacent workloads; asked about cross-border transfers and model keys.
3) Regulatory/export controls — any OFAC/ITAR screening we perform and restrictions on certain datasets.
4) Questionnaire — you said you'd send your standard vendor security questionnaire (VSQ) for us to complete.

Short next steps I propose:
- I will attach a redacted SOC 2 summary and controls mapping for now (see attachment).
- Please send the VSQ as an editable doc (we can return answers in-line within 48 business hours).
- I'll loop in our security lead (Vivek) and legal (Laura) for any specific export-control/contract language.
- If EU-region deployment is required, we can propose a Dedicated or Private deployment quote; I'll include options and rough cost delta.

If that works, can we target a 30-min follow-up next week with your security team? I can make Tue/Wed morning PT work.

Thanks — talk soon.

—Priyom

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: internal: MedBridge VSQ — suggested responses / flags

Priyom / Laura / Vivek — quick internal note after reviewing MedBridge's VSQ draft: 

- SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II audit in 2026-11; full report is restricted but we can share a redacted summary and our controls mapping (see Priyom's attach). Laura: we'll need to sign an NDA for full report disclosure.
- GDPR/HIPAA: We support GDPR processing via data-processing addendum (DPA) and offer Business Associate Agreement (BAA) for HIPAA-covered use cases; legal can share templates.
- EU residency: We currently run hosted inference in eu-west-1 and eu-central regions. For customers requiring tenancy isolation, Dedicated (reserved GPU pools) or Private (VPC/on-prem) deployments are options — Dedicated provides regional isolation without on-prem. Cost delta ~ 25–40% depending on committed throughput.
- Cross-border transfers: By default, logs/metrics used for platform telemetry are redacted and we provide config options to disable telemetry export; we can support contractual limitations on telemetry export.
- OFAC/ITAR: Redwood integrates sanctions-list checks at customer onboarding and transactional screening for exports. For ITAR, we do not host ITAR-restricted model weights; we can add contract language to prohibit certain data types and will escalate if required. Vivek: please confirm screening cadence and any export-control certificates we can provide.

I'll draft the answers to the highlighted VSQ sections and return as an XLSX. Priyom — if you're OK, I'll send back a completed answers workbook by COB Mon.

—Grace
Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Thanks, Elena — attaching our completed answers and the redacted SOC 2 summary. Quick read / summary for your security team: 

- SOC 2 Type II: Audit date 2026-11; redacted summary attached. Full report available under NDA.
- GDPR/HIPAA: We support DPA and BAA; legal team (Laura) can share templates and suggested contract language for residency and telemetry restrictions.
- EU-region availability: We can provision eu-west-1 or eu-central-1 for your tenant. For stronger isolation we recommend Dedicated or Private deployments; draft pricing options included in the workbook.
- Cross-border/export controls: We perform sanctions screening at onboarding and have opt-in telemetry export controls. We do not host ITAR-restricted model weights by default; contract language can be added to cover any special cases.
